authority: CBCC Phase 2 Review Analysis / Root-Cause / Repair consumer accounting

locked_behavior.first_class_object: Customer Review/CS/returns analysis is a first-class Phase 2 business authority independent from asset production review. Mature tools.feedback remains the deterministic aggregation/prioritization engine; the Phase 2 layer adds Agent-authored root-cause hypotheses, smallest responsible repair decisions, local verification and learning handoff.
locked_behavior.evidence_alignment_rule: When aggregated feedback data exists, an authored Review decision must align to an observed eight-class category. Review counts/categories are evidence signals, not permission to invent a different issue class.
locked_behavior.causal_boundary_rule: WORKING_HYPOTHESIS and EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED_HYPOTHESIS may be READY when their normal evidence/lineage is complete. Any confirmed/proven causal status additionally requires resolved causal evidence refs and an explicit defensible causal/diagnostic method; review frequency alone never proves root cause.
locked_behavior.responsible_layer_rule: Communication/expectation issues cannot default to Product Quality changes; Product Quality issues cannot be declared fixed by copy-only repair. repair_scope must be compatible with the issue class and the active responsible layer cannot simultaneously be frozen.
locked_behavior.smallest_repair_rule: Repair decisions require a bounded repair scope, frozen unrelated layers and an explicit WHY for not broadening the rework. FULL_PROJECT/GLOBAL/ALL_CONTENT style repair defaults cannot satisfy the smallest-repair contract.
locked_behavior.positive_value_rule: POSITIVE_VALUE is preservation/learning, not a fabricated defect/root-cause. It uses PRESERVE_LEARN and may not be forced through a repair action.
locked_behavior.no_feedback_rule: An explicit Review Analysis plan may materialize before raw feedback_rows are supplied. Runtime emits NO_CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DATA_SUPPLIED with total=0 and no fabricated counts/rates/root causes; the deterministic feedback aggregator is bypassed for the internal stub and the user's original request is restored.
locked_behavior.production_review_boundary: Production output QA/review workspace is a separate later execution/revision authority and cannot substitute for customer Review/CS/returns root-cause decisions.
locked_behavior.measurement_boundary: #11 defines local verify-after-repair fields and learning handoff only. Global A/B, P0/P1/P2, experiment governance and next-input Measurement closure remain Phase 2 subtask 12.
locked_behavior.canonical_rule: Canonical REVIEWS remains feedback_analysis.json. Production review workspace/execution_contract and Strategy fallback do not replace the first-class customer Review authority.

verified_behavior: Feedback aggregation/classification cannot false-pass a missing Agent-authored root-cause/repair decision.

Every repair decision requires root-cause hypothesis/layer/status, responsible layer, smallest repair scope, frozen unrelated layers, local verification, learning handoff, six-field density and REQ-088 lineage.
When aggregated feedback exists, the authored issue class must align with an observed eight-class category.
Review frequency, share or severity never proves causality. Confirmed/proven causal status requires separate causal evidence refs and an explicit approved causal/diagnostic method.
Communication/expectation issues cannot silently mutate Product Quality, Product Quality issues cannot be copy-only fixes, and repair scope must match the responsible issue domain.
The active responsible layer cannot also be listed as frozen in the same repair decision.
Broad FULL_PROJECT/GLOBAL/ALL_CONTENT redesign defaults cannot satisfy smallest-repair readiness.
POSITIVE_VALUE is modeled as PRESERVE_LEARN with preservation action and learning handoff rather than a fake defect/root-cause repair.
Unknown source IDs remain unresolved and cannot satisfy Review REQ-088 lineage.

Production output Review/QA cannot substitute for the Phase 2 customer Review/CS/returns business authority.
